provenance.reviewType: Post-run AI source-to-output review, preceded by independent pre-provider semantic review; not a human study.
provenance.sourceIntegrityScope: Read-only git HEAD and tracked-worktree status confirmed def141d7 after the run; the root run reports no source, prompt, example changes or retries.

preflight.independentCalculation: A separate Python formula derived from the English/Spanish source checked all four variants for each attendee before provider calls.
semanticFindings: Exactly one intended baseline disagreement: the teen consent exception is resident AND member for Alice and resident OR member for Bob.
Both unsafe texts make the student fee override and extend the closing instant by exactly 30 minutes.
All original ordered fees, date boundaries, age thresholds, independent flags and null denied fees agree with goldens and direct oracle.

languageReview.pair: Alice English source to generated Spanish
languageReview.assessment: Preserves minimum age 16, adult threshold 18, consent or simultaneous resident-and-member exception for teens, exact UTC millisecond opening/closing, independent flags, null denial fee, and every first-match fee in order. Name and style notes are listed separately.

languageReview.pair: Bob Spanish source to generated English
languageReview.assessment: Preserves resident OR member as sufficient for the teen consent waiver, including the explicit either-is-enough explanation. All dates, other admission conditions, fee amounts and first-match priority agree with the source.

languageReview.pair: Frozen unsafe English and Spanish to analyzed proposal
languageReview.assessment: Both complete proposal texts match the frozen input exactly. They extend closing from 02:15Z to 02:45Z while applying the requested student fee; the unsafe proposal is an authored adversarial input, not a spontaneous model error.

languageReview.pair: Generated repair English and Spanish to Alice baseline plus edit intent
languageReview.assessment: Both languages retain all non-fee paragraphs from the Alice baseline pair exactly. The first matching fee is now Student/Estudiante at 3250 cents before scholarship, so it overrides every discount. Remaining tiers preserve every nonstudent fee. Admission and the original 02:15Z exclusive close remain unchanged.

gateReview.unsafeWitness: An otherwise eligible nonstudent at 2027-02-20T02:15:00.000Z is denied by the intended policy but admitted at 6350 cents by the unsafe rewrite. This independently confirms an out-of-scope admission change.
gateReview.assessment: The source meanings support all recorded gate decisions. Parsed-rule checks alone would not establish translation fidelity; the separate source-to-text review supplies that additional check for this case.

liveEvidence.note: Oracle counts are from the inspected run evidence, not a new provider invocation or a new execution of the app evaluator by this reviewer.

textNotes.observation: Generated Spanish translates the event name Open Bench to Banco Abierto, whereas the supplied Spanish draft retains Open Bench. This is an event-name consistency issue; all admission and fee clauses remain faithful.
textNotes.suggestionForFutureWork: Preserve the proper event name consistently unless localization is explicitly requested. No output was changed during this run.

textNotes.observation: Generated Spanish uses the compact endpoint word exclusive. The following sentence explicitly says a submission at closing arrives late, so the exclusion remains unambiguous. The frozen Spanish input uses the plainer sin incluir ese instante. This is a clarity/style note, not a claim that the policy boundary changed.
textNotes.suggestionForFutureWork: Prefer sin incluir ese instante for plain Spanish. No output was changed during this run.

textNotes.observation: Ancillary Spanish explanations retain English fee labels, for example Primera regla de tarifa aplicable: Agreed student fee and Scholarship. The generated Spanish policy itself translates the tiers and gives the correct amounts.
textNotes.suggestionForFutureWork: Localize explanatory fee labels for Spanish readers. No output was changed during this run.

limitations: One fresh bilingual challenge and one run do not measure general reliability or Spanish-user comprehension.
This is an AI review, not independent human bilingual validation or a human usability study. The reviewer saw the outputs and reported results during the post-run review.

The direct oracle exhausts all ages 0–120 and all 32 independent flag assignments at the selected authored/returned boundaries and interval representatives; its 185856 checks are not a count of every possible timestamp.

The application gate operates over parsed rules. The source-to-text audit found no operative translation drift in this case, but finite rule checks cannot establish arbitrary natural-language faithfulness.
The unsafe rewrite was deliberately authored. It demonstrates rejection of that supplied scope violation, not a measured spontaneous model failure rate.
Simulated Alice/Bob votes do not establish real multiuser authentication or collaboration reliability.
Text/localization notes were preserved without tuning, retries, source changes, or edits to live outputs.
